B4.why: Values are preliminary 3 mm-mesh results. Three distinct refined contact attempts produced implausible excessive motion despite balanced reactions; wall forces and sharp-lip stress are not shown converged.
B4.notes: Wall forces are approximate section integrals, not validated values. 0.08 N gap engagement test and pad-force bound are documented in REPORT.md.
